summary: Nanexa AB (publ), a pharmaceutical company, develops injectable drug products in the Nordic countries, Europe, Asia, and North America. The company offers PharmaShell, a drug delivery system based on atomic layer deposition coating technology for controlled release of various types of active pharmaceutical substances. It also develops NEX-22, a glucagon-like peptide-1 analogue liraglutide that has completed Phase I trial for the treatment of type 2 diabetes; NEX-18, a drug from azacitidine to treat myelodysplastic syndrome; and NEX-20, a drug from lenalidomide for the treatment of multiple myeloma. The company has collaborations with Novo Nordisk to evaluate PharmaShell technology; and Moderna for the development of pharmaceutical products with active substances. Nanexa AB (publ) was founded in 2007 and is based in Uppsala, Sweden.
